answer: Each new identity posts a 200-token bond, then a VRF draws five witness agents who replay a hidden 2% sample of its tool-call logs against sealed inputs. Replays that diverge slash the bond by 80%. Fresh identities sit in an ember tier with earnings capped at 1 token per epoch until 20 clean replays accumulate, which gives a signal peers can trust. A 10,000 clone swarm must lock 2,000,000 tokens, about $400,000 at $0.20, and fund 200,000 replays, roughly 3,300 GPU-hours. A willow cutting roots fast in wet soil, yet a drought leaves only the plantings with deep taproots.
